source_hashes: All historical, profile and production source hashes frozen in registration; validate there before interpreting this contract.

ACTUATOR_TRACKING_SUSPECTED.meaning: Valid released measured-only insufficient progress after profile-qualified response opportunity, before frozen confirmation

ACTUATOR_TRACKING_PENDING.meaning: Old raw mismatch waiting path that caused nominal cold-start false DEGRADED

all_reason_retention: Collect every currently active channel reason in SafetyDecision.reasons and SafetyEnvelope.reason_codes; primary does not delete secondary reasons.

primary_reason.future_if_required: Pick among final highest-severity reasons; use prior frozen production tie-break if present; otherwise diagnostic PRESSURE>THERMAL>SENSOR>ACTUATOR_TRACKING>FF>OTHER; never change severity/envelope.

state_reducer: Maximum active severity under hierarchy_low_to_high; tracking cannot overwrite other channels.
envelope_combination: SUSPECTED contributes identity/no tracking-specific envelope; CONFIRMED selects existing generic FAULT fallback DP and fault_speed bounds; non-tracking restrictions follow unchanged Contract 15, including pressure-over-thermal authority. No new actuator command.
latching: Confirmed tracking invokes existing top-level FAULT latch. Restored measured motion is evidence only; existing explicit reset, valid sensors and recovery qualification own top-level clearing.
sensor_quality: INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT adds no new actuator failure. Existing sensor-invalid channel can independently contribute FAULT. Prior suspected evidence remains internal; prior confirmed latch and reason remain active.
thermal: Thermal PROTECTED/DERATE_REQUESTED contributes independently; tracking cannot suppress it. Final severity is maximum; all reasons retained.
pressure: Pressure FAULT contributes independently, remains FAULT with tracking suspected/confirmed, and retains pressure-over-thermal restriction priority.
ff: FF_DISABLED remains when tracking contributes NORMAL; suspected raises final to DEGRADED, confirmed to FAULT; local feedback/PLC continue under existing rules.
ownership: Contract14 deny-default; Safety restriction/envelope only; PLC sole final ActuatorCommand producer; no raw ACTUAL or hidden state; same-tick Safety-before-PLC authority unchanged.
next_phase_after_review: Phase 5R5.2.1R2R mapping contract revalidation, not direct R5.3R production port
